result.rationale: The diff changes the public members endpoint in app/controllers/groups_controller.rb to `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` with no upper bound, whereas the old code only applied client-supplied limit/offset to automatic groups and capped at a default of 200. Any client can now pass limit=10000000 and force a huge query plus serialization of all group users, a real resource-exhaustion vector introduced by this change.

adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the new pagination code sets `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and uses it directly in `group.users...limit(limit)` and serialization without any maximum cap. This allows a client to pass an arbitrarily large `limit` (e.g., 10,000,000), potentially forcing very large queries and responses (DoS risk).
